relationships.subject: GSK-843
relationships.evidence_quote: Both intrathecal administration of GSK-843 and EA alleviated mechanical and thermal pain behaviors induced by CFA and inhibited the expression of RIP3 and NLRP3 in the SDH of CFA mice.

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: Both intrathecal administration of GSK-843 and EA alleviated mechanical and thermal pain behaviors induced by CFA and inhibited the expression of RIP3 and NLRP3 in the SDH of CFA mice.

relationships.subject: RIP3
relationships.evidence_quote: Over-expression of RIP3 induces pain-like symptoms in mice and inhibits the regulatory effects of EA on inflammatory pain.

key_findings: Spinal RIP3 and NLRP3 increase after CFA; GSK-843 and EA reduce them and relieve pain.
RIP3 overexpression induces pain-like behavior and blunts EA analgesia.
